[Documention](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_treeitem.html#enum-treeitem-treecellmode) (as of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/92112) explains:
> The button is flat by default, you can use set_custom_as_button() to display it with a StyleBox.

But it is not very clear, however, from the engine code we can find out that it needs to be editable as well, otherwise it will draw as normal:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fde0616a0ea928471436f74b7cf176f9bff56dc7/scene/gui/tree.cpp#L2503-L2506
and for the stylebox logic, it needs to be set as button with `set_custom_as_button`:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fde0616a0ea928471436f74b7cf176f9bff56dc7/scene/gui/tree.cpp#L2517-L2530

So all this is required for it to appear as a "custom button" so the styleboxes apply:
```gdscript
    item.set_cell_mode(4, TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CUSTOM)
    item.set_editable(4, true)
    item.set_custom_as_button(4, true)
```
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/22dd21fd-d719-4b8c-b137-fe7b465b1ba5)

Also the Tree node is a mess overall, the item modes are confusing and hard to config etc. See: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/4579
